description: Design and development of core banking microservices. Architecting scalable, event-driven transaction and payment platforms, integrating databases, and maintaining cloud infrastructure.
Led cloud migration and architecture optimization projects on AWS. Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and established robust DevSecOps pipelines.
Developed robust, high-performance backend systems for digital banking services. Created secure APIs, optimized database queries, and implemented microservices.
Supervised software development lifecycle and provided technical leadership. Enforced best architectural practices, microservices design patterns, and agile processes.
Engineered enterprise application modules using Java SE/EE. Managed SQL databases, built desktop and web tools, and worked closely with clients to deliver bespoke requirements.
